risks: asm/include/unk_02023694.inc is a FAMILY-WIDE .public list shared by multiple .s files (sprite/cell-anim/G2d machinery); the bulk of it (Sys_AllocAndReadFile, all Sprite_*/SpriteList_*, all NNS_G2d*, GX_LoadOAM, GXS_LoadOAM, DC_FlushRange, MIi_CpuClear16, memset, _u32_div_f, FX_SinCosTable_, ClearMainOAM, ClearSubOAM, Sprite_GetCurrentAnimFrameExAttr, Sprite_GetCellAnim) is NEVER referenced inside unk_02023694.s itself -- do not generate prototypes/header entries for those from this file

exactly 31 of 68 functions are exported (match .inc lines 13-43: sub_02023738 through sub_02023FE4 inclusive, in that .inc order); the remaining 37 are not in .public and must stay static -- getting any of these wrong adds unnecessary header surface and IPA exposure

GF_AssertFail call-site shapes split into two distinct C idioms used throughout this file: (a) fall-through asserts where execution continues after the call regardless (write as GF_ASSERT(cond), see insights.md id gf-assert-direction), vs (b) guard asserts where the function RETURNS a sentinel value (0/NULL/FALSE) after the call (write as explicit if(){GF_AssertFail();return X;}, NOT the GF_ASSERT macro -- insights.md id assert-return-not-gf-assert). Misclassifying any of the ~20 occurrences will mismatch.

many null-checks use `add rD, rS, #0` (a register-copy that also sets flags in Thumb) immediately followed by bne/beq with NO separate cmp instruction; write straightforward `if (a0 != NULL)` so MWCC can fuse the copy+compare -- introducing an extra temp/cast could force a separate cmp and break the match

sub_020238BC has an apparently-dead second `bne` reusing the first cmp's flags right after the entry null-check -- looks like a nested/duplicate GF_ASSERT(a0 != NULL) compiled inside the a0-is-NULL branch; reproduce literally

the 0x1c/0x20/0x24 offsets mean completely different things in UnkStruct_02023D44 (userData/callback/-) versus UnkStruct_02023E04 (explicit VRAM key overrides) -- do not let struct-access notes from one bleed into the other when writing the two header types

do not include NNS SDK leaf headers (<nnsys/g3d/...>, gfd vram types) directly -- include only via global.h (insights.md id nns-leaf-headers-via-global), or MWCC will fail on undefined NNSG3dResMdlSet-family types

objdiff.py can false-positive on bl-relocation placeholder bytes for every external call in this heavily-NNS/Heap-calling file -- always confirm with chiri pkg -- compare, never accept on objdiff --summary alone (insights.md id objdiff-bl-placeholder-falsepos)

sub_02023F04 has 60+ call sites concentrated in asm/overlay_01_021F72DC.s (all still asm, no IPA risk yet) -- its delta/frame parameter type is the least-evidenced signature guess in this file and should be re-examined against that overlay's call-site setup before finalizing the header

sub_02023B38 and sub_020243FC have only structurally-inferred (low confidence) parameter roles for r1/r2 -- do not treat their signature_guess as load-bearing; re-derive from the actual decomp attempt
